messages:
Ibrahim N: opened a PR proposing schema additions to model-cards: provenance (bench run id + git SHA), a confidence-interval column for throughput numbers, and a tiny CLI snippet to validate runtime compatibility metadata. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/601
Kelsey R: interesting. why do we need a confidence interval field?
Ibrahim N: two reasons: 1) bench noise across runs can be large for small models on bursty infra, customers expect a sense of variance; 2) it helps SRE when deciding rollout thresholds (not just point estimates). I added a short footnote on methodology in the PR.
Yvonne T: can you paste the proposed CLI snippet for validating runtime metadata? want to make sure it's easy for contributors to run locally
Ibrahim N: snippet from PR:
```bash
# validate model-card runtime metadata (checks runtime_version, cuda_min, bench_id)
python tools/validate_card_metadata.py --file ./models/zephyrx/card.md
# exits non-zero on missing fields or format mismatches
```
Kelsey R: nice. please also add a GitHub action check so PRs touching model-cards run this validator automatically
Ibrahim N: added a draft GH Action in the PR; it runs tools/validate_card_metadata.py and posts a human-friendly comment if fields are missing. I linked a draft workflow in the PR description.
bench-bot: attached a representative bench run id used in examples: bench://2026-07-18/zephyrx-q4_1-4782
Yvonne T: schema nit: prefer the key name "bench_run_id" instead of just "bench_id" to be explicit
Ibrahim N: updated to bench_run_id across schema and generator outputs
Kelsey R: how are we populating confidence intervals? do you expect to run the bench suite multiple times per variant?
Ibrahim N: generator will compute 95% CIs from the last N runs for a variant (N default=5). if <3 runs available it writes "n/a" and the card shows a small warning. I added this behavior in the PR notes.
Yvonne T: docs CI warning: linkcheck flagged a stale link to the benchmark CSV in the Benchmarks section :x: https://ci.redwood.ai/links/601
Ibrahim N: fixed CSV path and pushed. also added a short authoring note in the model-card template describing how to reference bench_run_id and link back to bench.
Kelsey R: can we be careful about PII in bench links (some runs include internal host tags)? ensure generator strips any internal-only metadata from public URLs
Ibrahim N: good catch  generator now rewrites bench links to the public bench dashboard URL and drops internal tags. added unit test in tools/ to validate redaction.
docs-bot: docs CI (lint + linkcheck + metadata validator) passed :white_check_mark: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/601
Kelsey R: LGTM pending a short blurb in the contribution guide so future contributors know to run the validator locally
Ibrahim N: added contribution guide blurb and a one-liner to the PR description. ready to merge after one more quick review
Yvonne T: looks good to me, especially the redaction step. small editorial nit: change "confidence interval" to "95% CI" in the table header to be explicit
Ibrahim N: updated header. merging after CI green. :tada:
docs-bot: merged PR #601 and triggered docs preview deploy https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/model-catalog/zephyrx-provenance
meta-bot: created follow-up issue to surface bench_run_id in the compat matrix generator: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/issues/315
bench-bot: bench dashboard updated with canonical run (2026-07-18)
Ibrahim N: leaving an infra follow-up to wire the validator into PR templates and make it a required check for model-catalog edits: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/142
Kelsey R: thanks  this should cut down on stale tables and mysterious bench divergences
Ibrahim N: closing thread  thanks everyone
